run_f_gold: run f_gold to make an array lexicographically smallest using at most k consecutive swaps
test_f_gold: test f_gold against filled function using the provided parameter sets and compare results
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which performs a modified selection sort limited by k swap budget
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that finds minimum within k range and bubbles it to current position
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return a new sorted array instead of mutating the input list in place
